title: The History of Caliph Vathek
author: William Beckford
description: "The History of Caliph Vathek" by William Beckford is a Gothic novel composed in French beginning in 1782 and first published in English in 1786.
longDescription: The story follows Vathek, a depraved and tyrannical caliph with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, who encounters a mysterious stranger promising magical treasures and access to forbidden power. Seduced by promises of ultimate knowledge and the keys to the Palace of Underground Fire, Vathek makes a dark pact that demands terrible sacrifices and leads him down a path of increasingly heinous acts, rejecting salvation at every turn.

authorInfo.bio: William Beckford (1760–1844) is the author of The History of Caliph Vathek. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
